title: TIME ± INTERVAL wraps around midnight; no date_trunc of a TIME
verdict: no-finding: the reference wraps too; months refused
description: `TIME + INTERVAL` wraps around midnight in both directions: the result is the time plus the interval's microseconds, modulo a day. `TIME '23:30' + INTERVAL 1 HOUR = 00:30`, `TIME '00:30' - INTERVAL 1 HOUR = 23:30`, and a negative interval subtracts.

The interval's days and months are dropped: `TIME '10:00' + INTERVAL 1 DAY` and `+ INTERVAL 1 MONTH` are `10:00`; `+ INTERVAL '1 day 2 hours'` is `12:00`. Its microseconds may exceed a day: `+ INTERVAL 25 HOUR` is `11:00`.
DuckDB has no `date_trunc` of a TIME (a binder error). sverify's SQL truncates it on 1970-01-01 and casts back: `CAST(date_trunc(u, DATE '1970-01-01' + t) AS TIME)` (`DuckDBDialect.time_trunc`).

`TIME - INTERVAL` negates the interval first, and raises where its microseconds are -2^63: `TIME '12:00:00' - INTERVAL '-4611686018427387904 microseconds -4611686018427387904 microseconds'` is `Out of Range Error: Interval micros value out of range` (DuckDB's `types/test_interval_negation_overflow.test`). `TIME + ` the same interval wraps.
reference: A time of day plus a constant interval of days or less is `Time.timeOfDay` (the microseconds modulo a day, Euclidean) of the sum, as DuckDB computes. An interval with months is refused (`temporalArith`): DuckDB drops them, which the model does not follow.
Truncating a time of day to an hour, minute, second, millisecond or microsecond is `Time.trunc`, a floor of the microseconds, which stays within the day. Coarser units are refused.

The SQL lift refuses `TIME - INTERVAL` with -2^63 microseconds, where DuckDB raises, and an interval beyond 64-bit microseconds. Plans from the Ibis producer reduce the interval modulo a day, so the written SQL never negates such an interval.

evidence.observed: Binder Error: No function matches the given name and argument types 'date_trunc(STRING_LITERAL, TIME)'

evidence.sql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('hour', DATE '1970-01-01' + TIME '10:37:12.5') AS TIME)

evidence.observed: Out of Range Error: Interval micros value out of range
